```cypher
OPTIONAL MATCH (v)-[:is_drawn_on]->(s:Sheet)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a:ActuatingFunction)-[:control]->(v)
OPTIONAL MATCH (c:ProcessInstrumentationFunction)-[:send_signal_to]->(a)
RETURN v.tag AS tag, labels(v) AS labels, v.dexpi_class AS dexpi_class, v.piping_component_name AS name, c.loop_tag AS loop_tag, collect(DISTINCT s.sheet_id) AS sheets
```

```cypher
MATCH path = (start:PlantItem {tag:'V-13-7'})-[:send_to*]->(end:PlantItem {tag:'GV-12-10'})
UNWIND nodes(path) AS n
WITH path, n
WHERE (n:Equipment OR n:Valve OR n:BallValve OR n:GlobeValve OR n:CheckValve OR n:OperatedValve)
RETURN [x IN nodes(path) WHERE (x:Equipment OR x:Valve OR x:BallValve OR x:GlobeValve OR x:CheckValve OR x:OperatedValve) | x.tag] AS ordered_items
LIMIT 1
```

MATCH (t:Tank {tag:'T-26-1'})<-[:send_to*1..]-(v:PlantItem)
WHERE (v:BallValve OR v:GlobeValve OR v:OperatedValve) AND NOT v:CheckValve
RETURN DISTINCT v.tag AS isolation_valve
ORDER BY isolation_valve

MATCH (t:PlantItem {tag:'T-26-1'})
MATCH (v:PlantItem:PipingComponent)-[:send_to*1..]->(t)
WHERE (v:BallValve OR v:OperatedValve OR v:GlobeValve OR v:CheckValve)
  AND NOT v:CheckValve
  AND NOT v:GlobeValve
RETURN DISTINCT v.tag AS isolation_valve
ORDER BY isolation_valve

MATCH (start:PlantItem {tag:'V-13-7'}), (end:PlantItem {tag:'GV-12-10'})
MATCH p = shortestPath((start)-[:send_to*1..50]->(end))
UNWIND nodes(p) AS n
RETURN n.tag AS tag, labels(n) AS labels, [r IN relationships(p) | r.line_number] AS line_numbers
ORDER BY [idx IN range(0, length(p)) | idx]

MATCH p = (src:Equipment)-[:send_to*1..]->(t:PlantItem {tag:'T-26-1'})
WHERE src.tag <> 'T-26-1'
WITH [n IN nodes(p) WHERE n:GateValve OR n:BallValve] AS valves_on_path
UNWIND valves_on_path AS v
RETURN DISTINCT v.tag AS block_valve
ORDER BY block_valve

```cypher
MATCH (t:PlantItem {tag:'T-26-1'})
MATCH (v:PlantItem)
WHERE (v:BallValve OR v:GlobeValve OR v:CheckValve OR v:OperatedValve)
  AND (v)-[:send_to*1..]->(t)
  AND EXISTS { MATCH (src:Equipment)-[:send_to*1..]->(v) WHERE src <> t }
RETURN DISTINCT v.tag AS valve_to_close
ORDER BY valve_to_close
```

MATCH (t:PlantItem:Tank {tag:'T-13-5'})
MATCH p=(src)-[:send_to*1..]->(t)
WHERE (src:Equipment OR src:UnresolvedOffPageConnector)
  AND src <> t
  AND NONE(n IN nodes(p) WHERE n:Tank AND n <> t)
WITH [n IN nodes(p) WHERE n:OperatedValve OR n:CheckValve | n.tag] AS valves, p
RETURN DISTINCT valves AS isolation_valves
ORDER BY isolation_valves

MATCH p = (v:PlantItem)-[:send_to*1..]->(t:Tank {tag:'T-26-1'})
WHERE (v:BallValve OR v:GlobeValve OR v:CheckValve OR v:OperatedValve OR v:ActuatingFunction)
  AND (up)-[:send_to]->(v)
RETURN DISTINCT v.tag AS valve
ORDER BY valve

MATCH (t:Tank {tag:'T-26-1'})
MATCH (v:PlantItem)
WHERE (v:BallValve OR v:GlobeValve OR v:OperatedValve)
  AND ( ()-[:send_to]->(v) )
MATCH path = (v)-[:send_to*1..]->(t)
WHERE none(n IN nodes(path)[0..-1] WHERE n <> v AND (n:BallValve OR n:GlobeValve OR n:CheckValve OR n:OperatedValve))
RETURN DISTINCT v.tag AS valve;

MATCH (tank:Tank {tag:'T-26-1'})
MATCH p = (src:Equipment)-[:send_to*1..]->(tank)
WHERE src <> tank
UNWIND nodes(p) AS n
WITH DISTINCT n
WHERE any(l IN labels(n) WHERE l IN ['BallValve', 'GlobeValve', 'OperatedValve'])
  AND NOT n:CheckValve
  AND NOT EXISTS { (:PlantItem)-[:control]->(n) }
RETURN DISTINCT n.tag AS valve_tag

MATCH p=(src)-[:send_to*1..]->(t:Tank {tag:'T-13-5'})
UNWIND nodes(p) AS n
WITH DISTINCT n
WHERE (n:GateValve OR n:BallValve)
RETURN DISTINCT n.tag AS tag

MATCH (tank:Tank {tag:'T-13-5'})
MATCH (v)
WHERE (v:BallValve OR v:GlobeValve OR v:OperatedValve)
  AND NOT ( (:ActuatingFunction)-[:control]->(v) )
MATCH p = (v)-[:send_to*1..]->(tank)
RETURN DISTINCT v.tag AS valve_to_close
ORDER BY valve_to_close

MATCH (t:Tank {tag:'T-13-5'})
MATCH (t)-[:send_to]-(v)
WHERE (v:OperatedValve OR v:CheckValve)
RETURN DISTINCT v.tag AS szelep

MATCH (t:Tank {tag:'T-13-5'})
MATCH (v)-[*1..20]->(t)
WHERE (v:BallValve OR v:GlobeValve OR v:OperatedValve)
  AND NOT v:CheckValve
  AND EXISTS { MATCH (src:Equipment)-[*1..20]->(v) }
RETURN DISTINCT v.tag AS valve

MATCH (t:Tank {tag:'T-13-5'})
MATCH (v:PlantItem)
WHERE any(l IN labels(v) WHERE l IN ['BallValve', 'GlobeValve', 'CheckValve', 'OperatedValve'])
WHERE EXISTS { MATCH p=(v)-[:send_to*1..]->(t) }
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (e:Equipment)
    WHERE e <> t AND e <> v
    MATCH p2=(e)-[:send_to*0..]->(t)
    WHERE none(n IN nodes(p2) WHERE n = v)
  }
RETURN DISTINCT v.tag AS valve_to_close
